prompt.project_info: Create a casual cozy high-angle bedroom portrait of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long voluminous curly dark-blonde hair, relaxed soft gaze and natural expression, wearing a white long-sleeve ribbed top and white ankle socks.
prompt.composition_elements: Comfortably lying on her stomach with upper body propped on elbows, legs naturally bent and feet crossed, white and floral bedding, large mirror against beige wall, modern silver ribbon-style ceiling light.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight from the side, gentle shadows, relaxed cozy intimate-but-non-sexual bedroom mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-angle smartphone selfie, realistic hair, fabric, bedding and skin texture, natural color and soft depth.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A casual cozy high-angle bedroom portrait of an approved adult woman with long voluminous curly dark-blonde hair and a relaxed soft gaze. She wears a white long-sleeve ribbed top and white ankle socks, lying comfortably on her stomach with her upper body propped on her elbows and her feet naturally crossed. The bedroom has white and floral bedding, a large rectangular mirror leaning against a beige wall, and a modern silver ribbon-style ceiling light. Use soft natural daylight from the side, gentle shadows, realistic hair and fabric, natural skin, high-angle smartphone selfie texture, and an intimate but non-sexual cozy mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, exposed midriff, lingerie, lip-biting, sexualized prone pose, body-part emphasis, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
